test_title: PYST 46: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 3rd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: ‘Atlantic’ is related to ‘Ocean’ in the same way as ‘Panama’ is related to ‘________’.
solution: The logic followed here is : • **Atlantic** is name of the **ocean**. Similarly, • **Panama** is name of the **canal**. Hence, **"Canal"** is the correct answer.
